scope: Prevent the removed NGE player combat level from regaining authority in dormant or retained GCW compatibility ratios while preserving authored NPC difficulty, Publish 14 faction standing and rank, and later-content data whose NGE progression effects remain retired.

findings: Publish 14.1 character combat capability is derived from learned combat skill boxes under the 250-point skill budget, not an NGE player combat level.
The retained GCW library still held seven player-side level reads in a dormant PvP credit helper and a compatibility NPC-credit helper.
releaseGcwPointCredit has no caller in the compiled script tree, getNpcKillCredit is referenced only by the retired GCW-point grant chain, and native pclib no longer calls releaseGcwPointCredit.
The NGE current/lifetime GCW point pipeline remains hard-retired, while Publish 14 faction standing, faction rank, and open-world battlefield systems remain authoritative.
Routing compatibility ratios through getPrecuEncounterDifficulty closes future NGE precedence without re-enabling retired GCW progression or replacing authored NPC levels.
